title: pinto beans
ingredients: 1 small yellow onion; halved or quartered
1 lb. dry pinto beans; soaked overnight, drained, and rinsed
4 1/2 cups water; enough to cover beans by about 2/3"
instructions: To the Instant pot, add onion and garlic, drained and rinsed beans, salt and bay leaves
Pour in water until it sits about an inch above the top of the beans. Stir gently to combine.
Cook on High Pressure for 10 minutes. Allow the pot to undergo a natural pressure release for 15 minutes before venting any remaining steam.
Remove the lid and simmer until broth has slightly thicked (~10-15 minutes).
Stir in 1-2 Tbsp of the aged sherry vinegar. Taste, and add more vinegar or extra salt if needed.
notes: Adding the vinegar at the very end is crucial; pressure cooking the acid would make the bean skins tough. Optionally, saute the onion and garlic in olive oil before adding the rest of the ingredients. Also optionally, add cumin powder or a sliced pepper to the cooker.
